title: Crossing of the Andes
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Crossing of the Andes", at revision 1374600996, opens: "The Crossing of the Andes was one of the most important feats in the Argentine and Chilean wars of independence. A combined army of Argentine soldiers and Chilean exiles crossed the Andes mountains to invade Chile, leading to its liberation from Spanish rule." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q968126, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "feat in the sudamerican wars of independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
